sources: Zhao & Epley (2021). Insufficiently complimentary?: Underestimating the positive impact of compliments creates a barrier to expressing them. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 121(2), 239-256. Givers underestimated how positive recipients would feel and overestimated awkwardness; strongly underestimated how well-phrased recipients judged them; recipients responded to warmth more than phrasing (via Psychology Today, Markman 2021).
